map: Use case: stylized-concept. A polished painterly portrait 2:3 illustrated overworld map for a gentle children's fantasy adventure. Three DISTINCT large explorable regions arranged vertically connected by a subtle winding luminous path: lower third a sunny floating sky-island base with tiny stone buildings and crystal tower; middle third an emerald enchanted forest island with immense ancient tree and gentle stream; upper third a violet indigo cosmic island with a small futuristic observatory and rings of planets in a starry sky. Islands drift in layered clouds, gold sunlight gradually transitions into celestial twilight upward. Clear spacious centers on each region for real UI labels to be overlaid separately. Full-bleed scenic artwork, ornate but calm, immersive depth, not a UI screenshot. No text, numbers, labels, buttons, characters, card frames or icons. Distinct visual silhouettes readable on a phone.
